body:
## What changed
Student app shell only. No content, routes, migrations or config.
- **Nav (D1):** My Space, Learning Hub, Practice Studio, Exam Centre, My Results, in that order. Help Centre sits outside the five, in the sidebar foot (still links the public `/help` until P11 builds the student one).
- **Bottom nav below 1024px:** `StudentBottomNav`, short labels (My Space / Learning / Practice / Exams / Results), full names as `aria-label`, landmark "Main sections", targets `min-h-14 min-w-11`, visible focus ring, safe-area padding. The page body gains bottom padding so nothing hides behind it.
- **Removed from the sidebar:** "Stage 3" and "NAPLAN" badges, the "Scholar - Lvl 12 - 840xp" line, the non-functional search box and its ⌘K, and the "Session 2025-26 / NSW NESA v9.0" chip.
- **My Progress** leaves the nav (D5); `/student/engagement` stays reachable from My Space ("View My Progress" on the recent-activity card).
- **`docs/design.md` §8.2:** rewritten as a scope rule. §8.2 governs marketing, parent and account surfaces (parent billing keeps the header); the student app uses the sidebar shell and bottom nav. The header spec itself is unchanged.

## Assertions changed (labels only, no assertion loosened)
- `e2e/auth/a11y-student-dashboard.spec.ts`, both keyboard-walk tests: `key.includes("Dashboard")` -> `"My Space"`, `key.includes("My Progress")` -> `"My Results"`; plus the explanatory comment. Order assertions are unchanged.
- `src/tests/unit/navigation-graph.test.ts`: a comment only (no assertion).
- `student-shell.test.tsx` is untouched: it tests the older `StudentShell` (assignments and other pages), which still says "Dashboard".

## Added
`src/tests/components/student-portal-nav.test.tsx` (5 tests): the five labels in order, Help Centre outside them, active state, placeholders absent, bottom-nav labels / aria-labels / 44px classes / `lg:hidden`.

## For the owner
- **D3, streak and week dots:** real data, still in the sidebar, nothing similar added. Left as is.
- **Kept on purpose:** the top bar's "Open menu" disclosure (the authenticated a11y suite drives it; it is redundant with the bottom nav and could go later), and the Singapore Maths Sample item (flag-gated, appears after the five).
- **Not touched, still placeholders:** the top bar's "Term 3 - Week 4" and goal pills, "Edit interests & goals", and the disabled Settings button. They are removed with their pages in P3-P5/P11.
- **Public-site "Learning Hub" occurrences (not edited; separate "Resources" workstream):** `src/app/learn/page.tsx`, `src/app/resources/page.tsx`, `src/app/globals.css`, `src/features/landing/{content.ts, programme-status.ts, components/primitives.tsx, components/Programmes.tsx, components/showcase-screens.tsx}`. `src/app/practice/session/page.tsx` also says "Learning Hub"/"Back to Learn" in student-facing error copy; P6 owns that page.
- The old `StudentShell`/`student-nav.ts` (assignments) still says "Dashboard"; out of scope.

## Test results
- `tsc --noEmit`: clean. `eslint` on `src/features/student` and the new test: clean.
- Targeted: `student-portal-nav`, `student-shell`, `navigation-graph`, `student-discovery-hub`: 23 tests passed.
- Full `npm test`: **not completed locally** - the run was stopped by the host for low memory. CI will run it.
- **Not run here:** build (Turbopack rejects the worktree `node_modules` junction), `test:rls`, `test:e2e`, `test:e2e:auth`. The e2e edits above are therefore unexecuted; CI will run them.

## Known gap (decide at the My Results phase)
`/results` has a pass-through layout and renders its own chrome, so the sidebar and bottom nav disappear on that destination while the nav still marks "My Results" active. Not fixed here. Decision for P10: either `/results` adopts the student portal shell, or My Results points at a new in-shell page.

## WCAG 2.5.3 (Label in Name)
Bottom-nav accessible names now start with the visible word: `aria-label = shortLabel === label ? label : "<short> — <full>"` (e.g. "Exams — Exam Centre"). A test asserts every item's accessible name contains its visible text.

## UNVERIFIED
Visual layout at 320-1023px (no browser run here); the bottom nav's fit with the open "Open menu" panel.
